description: Spell a monetary amount in words, the way a cheque or an invoice requires — "Four Thousand and Fifty Naira and Seventy-Five Kobo Only". Supports NGN, USD, EUR and GBP with the correct major and minor unit names. It is the row that goes above the signature line on the invoices at https://zaleso.com/invoice
name: amount_in_words
title: Amount in words
